assumption_to_test: A compact schema-plus-validator baseline is enough to make the quality theory operational and AI-verifiable without building an application.
smallest_testable_validation: Create a sample QIF package and run a local validator that checks entity references, required fields, evidence confidence inputs, verdict derivation constraints, and acceptance gates.
expected_learning: Whether the framework can be executed by humans or AI agents from artifacts alone.
expected_cost: One focused repository slice: docs, schemas, sample data, validator, and runtime evidence.
success_threshold: The validator returns pass for the sample package and fails if required QIF references or confidence inputs are removed.
